configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Release OpenCore, kexts and drivers. The EFI you boot.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: DEBUG builds of OpenCore, every kext and the drivers, plus any CONFIG Debug edits. Builds alongside release; both variants stay pinned in ocmake.lock.

configurePresets.name: offline
configurePresets.description: Release with no network access at all. Fails if ocmake.lock or the download cache is incomplete, so it is the check that a fresh clone can build.

configurePresets.name: update
configurePresets.description: Ignores ocmake.lock and re-resolves every pinned item, rewriting the lock. Use after bumping a version or to refresh VERSION latest.

workflowPresets.name: release
workflowPresets.displayName: Build and validate the release EFI

workflowPresets.name: debug
workflowPresets.displayName: Build and validate the debug EFI
